Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.lead: What this site stores about you, and how to delete it. Last updated 10 November 2026.

stored.title: What is stored
stored.account: When you sign in with Google: your email address, name, profile picture link and Google account ID, plus when you signed up and last signed in. Nothing else is requested from Google.
stored.tracker: What you enter in the tracker: applications, notes, cover letters, skills and any job descriptions you save with them.
stored.aiUsage: If you use AI analysis: how many analyses you ran each day, so the daily limit works.
stored.aiResults: AI analysis results, so the same job description is not analysed twice: the details found and the visa sentences quoted from it. They are filed under a fingerprint of the text, not under your account, and the full text is not kept.

notStored.title: What is not stored
notStored.analyse: The full text of job descriptions you analyse without saving. It is never written to the logs.
notStored.tracking: No ads, no analytics and no tracking cookies. Your data is not sold, and only goes to the services named on this page.

browser.title: Cookies and browser storage
browser.session: One cookie, session, keeps you signed in for 7 days (24 hours for a demo). Scripts on the page cannot read it.
browser.local: Your theme and your table or cards choice are saved in your browser and never sent to the server.
browser.google: The Google sign-in button is loaded from Google, and Google's own privacy policy covers it.

where.title: Where it is kept
where.hosting: The website runs on Vercel. The database runs on a server in AWS's London region.
where.backups: The database is backed up every night. Backups are kept in AWS storage in London for 30 days.
where.logs: Vercel and the server keep short-term request logs, including IP addresses, to keep the site running and limit abuse.
where.ai: AI analysis sends the job description to Anthropic's Claude API. Anthropic deletes it and the result within 30 days, keeps them for up to 2 years only if its safety systems flag them, and does not use them to train its models.

delete.title: Deleting your data
delete.how: Open the account menu (your picture, top right) and choose Delete my account. Your account, its Google sign-in link, all your applications and your AI analysis counts are deleted straight away.
delete.backups: Copies in the nightly backups disappear within 30 days, when those backups expire.
delete.export: Want a copy first? Use Export CSV on the Applications page.
delete.demo: Demo accounts and their data are deleted automatically after 24 hours.

sources.title: Where the public data comes from
sources.register: Sponsor data is the Home Office <register>register of licensed sponsors</register>, published on GOV.UK under the Open Government Licence v3.0. The date of the copy in use is shown at the bottom of every page.
sources.demo: Demo applications are made up. The company names come from the public register.

Terms.title: Terms
Terms.lead: The rules for using this site, in short. Last updated 8 November 2026.

advice.title: Not immigration advice
advice.info: This site organises public information. It is not legal or immigration advice, and it does not tell you whether you can get a visa.
advice.adviser: For advice about your own situation, talk to a regulated immigration adviser or solicitor.

guarantees.title: No guarantees
guarantees.register: A company on the register holds a sponsor licence. That does not mean it will sponsor a particular job. A company missing from the register may still be able to sponsor, for example under a parent company or another legal name.
guarantees.date: The register shown is a copy from the date at the bottom of the page. Check <register>GOV.UK</register> for the latest version.
guarantees.analysis: Job description analysis is automated and can be wrong. Read the original text before you rely on it.
guarantees.service: The site is provided as is. It may change, have outages or close.

account.title: Your account
account.delete: You can delete your account at any time from the account menu. <privacy>Privacy</privacy> explains what is stored and what deleting removes.
account.use: Do not use the site to break the law, overload it or collect its data automatically. Requests are rate limited.
